summary: MMR-diverse RAG few-shot (k=3) on champion adapter
hypothesis: Swapping top-2 semantic-nearest demos for MMR-diverse exemplars (k=3) should expose the adapter to a broader union of decision-critical axes and break the coverage ceiling, because the nearest-pair demos likely cluster around the same axis and leave others unseen.
technique: RAG retrieval using Maximal Marginal Relevance (λ=0.6, k=3) to select mutually-diverse corpus exemplars, injected as few-shot context into a single greedy on-device call on the champion LoRA adapter (adapter_v2a_e1).
result: Scored 0.382 on the full-30 greedy eval (3 wins / 1 tie / 25 losses vs Sonnet), down 0.027 from the champion (0.409) and below exp040's plain top-2 nearest RAG (0.405). Coverage stayed pinned at 3 and non-redundancy actually dropped to 3 (vs 4 for exp040), confirming that diversifying demonstrations does not diversify the output — the hypothesis was falsified and the run was discarded.
